rationale: MIMIC-IV is named, a version is given only through the reference list (v1.0; the upstream build README says v2.2, so the version is not cleanly pinned), the platform is DuckDB/PhysioNet, and each task row maps to a per-stay SQL record via stay_id and derived tables. Scored 2 on a lenient reading of the version; a stricter coder could give 1.
